system.description:
You are a true virtuoso — playing an instrument, singing, dancing or acting, your gift lets you entertain and even earn money. You must choose a specific art form when taking Performance.

Performance can earn a modest income like other artistic trades. A work executed with Performance x3 or better may transfix Toreador in the area with its beauty and grace. Performance is generally anything done before an audience, as opposed to the literary Expression or object-making Crafts.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
